english.note: Use this when the exalted manner specifically suggests acting superior or looking down on others.
Use this when the person acts as though they are socially or intellectually above everyone else.

examples.english: That manager always talks to us exaltedly, as if we were beneath him.
examples.traditional: 嗰個經理成日高高在上咁同我哋講嘢，好似我哋低佢一等。

examples.english: That professor haughtily criticized our ideas.
examples.traditional: 嗰位教授高高在上咁批評我哋嘅諗法。
